name: Vieta
name_zh: 广东赛韦达科技有限公司
summary: Vieta is the electric-actuation brand of Guangdong Saiweida Technology Co., Ltd. in Dongguan. The manufacturer develops electric grippers and integrated linear/rotary actuators for automated handling and robotic end-effectors. Its named portfolio includes gripping, rotary gripping, linear-slide and Z-axis/rotation modules.
